## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use the right arm to press the smooth metal bell's top center.

Task description: The target is the silver metal bell with a black base at the front right of the table. Use the right arm to press the center of its top.

Success criteria: The right-arm gripper is closed and makes actual contact and presses near the center of the bell top. Merely hovering above it does not count as completion.

## Execution tips

- Close the right gripper above the bell where there is clearance, so the contact surface of the closed fingertips covers the small center button. Avoid placing two open fingers across the press point.
- Approach the small central button from above with small downward movements, reducing lateral brushing that could make the fingertip slide along the smooth bell cover.
